description: Full metadata for one app: name, developer, ratings, price, version, size, screenshots, store URL. Use the numeric app id (iOS) or package name (Android).

app_id.description: iOS: numeric Apple id (e.g. '389801252' for Instagram). Android: package name (e.g. 'com.instagram.android').

country.description: ISO-2 storefront code, e.g. us, gb, de, jp. Defaults to us.

lang.description: Language code, e.g. en, es, fr, ja. Defaults to en.

store.description: Store to query: "ios" (Apple App Store) or "android" (Google Play).

name: get_app
title: App details
